title: D4: One-page workshop and office quick guides
public_pr_body:
D4: One-page workshop and office quick guides. Adds a plain-language procedure under docs/ or tests/ and a job handover. Prepared for build/test by 6 November and conditional go-live on 12 November 2026.

Validation: checked repository controls/release source and `git diff --check`. Documentation only. Operator rehearsal, private contact/setting verification and live evidence are explicitly NOT RUN. No database SQL, production changes, merge or deployment.

Independent review and the named operator checks remain required. Builder 3 CM/CN/CO/CP/CQ untouched. Draft only; no Ready label.
